Audit and assurance services that support regulatory compliance, reliable financial reporting and a clearer understanding of your business.

Our audit and assurance practice delivers objective oversight designed to strengthen corporate governance, fulfill statutory mandates, and provide stakeholders with dependable financial clarity. We examine accounting systems, test internal controls, and verify compliance under Indian and International GAAP. Whether performing annual statutory audits, internal system reviews, tax audits, or foreign remittance certifications (Forms 15CA/15CB), our methodology centers on disciplined risk assessment, transparent communication, and timely closure.

Our approach

Our approach considers the business environment alongside the financial statements. We review operational workflows, internal financial controls, and statutory reporting to identify areas of risk and communicate practical recommendations clearly to leadership and audit committees.

How is the scope of an engagement determined?

Services are agreed based on your requirements, applicable professional standards and the circumstances of the matter. Contact the firm to discuss the relevant scope and documentation.

Can related practice areas be combined?

Yes. Depending on the engagement, our partners can coordinate accounting, tax, assurance and advisory expertise, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.

Common questions.

Does PSB Associates provide audit services?

P S B & Associates LLP provides statutory audit, internal audit, tax audit, certification and assurance services. Audit engagements are subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.

What information should I share for an audit enquiry?

Share the entity type, financial year, nature of the business and the audit or certification required. The team can then discuss the scope and records needed. Please send only a brief overview through the enquiry form.

Can PSB help prepare records for an audit?

The firm provides accounting and compliance support as well as assurance services. Whether these services can be combined depends on the engagement and applicable independence requirements.
